'''Bleeding''' is a [[Effects|Potion Effect]] introduced by the Mod. This Effect damages Entities over time, in a similar way to Poison, doing 6% of the Entity maximum health every "hit". The damage is doubled if they move. Bleeding cannot inflict more than 100 damage.

Bleeding cannot be removed by drinking Milk.
